purpose: Replace an expected description or choice with a more fitting one.
keywords: Rather than being angry, I am worried.
This work is difficult, but that actually makes it interesting.
I would rather go by train than by car.
restrictions: Often follows a denied or qualified first interpretation.
mistake: It marks a better-fitting alternative, not simply another added option.

segments.role: Replace an expected description or choice with a more fitting one. むしろ + preferred judgment / alternative

examples.translation: Rather than being angry, I am worried.
